detailed_description: Meta Description Generator creates SEO meta description options from a page topic, target keyword, and optional call to action. The real component shows multiple copy-ready suggestions with live character counts and 120-160 character guidance so writers can compare concise search snippets before editing the final page description. It uses browser-side templates and does not call an AI API, audit rankings, fetch search results, or guarantee higher CTR.
usage_steps: Enter the page topic you want the description to summarize.
Add a target keyword and optional call to action.
Review the generated description options and character counts.
Copy the strongest draft and edit it for accuracy, page fit, and natural keyword use.
usage_examples: Draft meta descriptions for a blog post before publishing.
Compare concise snippets for a product, tool, or landing page.
Add a call to action while keeping the description near the recommended length.

faqs.question: Is Meta Description Generator free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tool is free to use in your browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Does the tool upload my inputs?
faqs.answer: No. The calculation or generation runs locally in the browser for this utility.

faqs.question: Does Meta Description Generator use an AI API?
faqs.answer: No. This tool uses local templates and formatting logic in your browser; it does not call an AI model.

faqs.question: Does it guarantee a better search snippet?
faqs.answer: No. It creates draft descriptions and character guidance only. Search engines may rewrite snippets based on the query and page content.
